summary: Full backend + frontend testing for TelePulse Telegram Ad Engine. Wrote pytest suite (11 tests, all passing) covering /api/stats, list endpoints, /api/accounts fake-session graceful 400, /api/session-test 404 & 400 for seeded fake account, /api/upload + /api/uploads/{path} serve back via Emergent object storage, and full Campaign CRUD flow (create -> list -> start -> stop -> delete) using a fake account seeded directly into Mongo. Frontend Playwright tests confirmed: dashboard loads with dark theme, sidebar nav switches between Overview/Accounts/Campaigns/Logs/Session Tester, stats cards render for all 4 keys, Add Account modal opens, empty-submit shows 'All fields are required' toast, fake-session submit returns 400 gracefully with error toast (accounts list remains []), Session Tester send-with-no-account shows 'Select an account' toast. No crashes, no 500s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py resume_campaigns startup: if a running campaign references an account whose Telethon session is fake/invalid, campaign_loop repeatedly logs failure but keeps looping forever with interval sleep — consider auto-stopping after N consecutive client errors.
storage.py: init_storage uses a module-level cached key with no thread-safety; fine for single-worker uvicorn but should be documented.
telegram_service.get_client: caches a client keyed by account_id but does not invalidate cache if the underlying account document changes (e.g. session_string rotated).
server.py upload_media stores the file record but there is no cleanup path when a campaign is deleted — orphaned files accumulate in object storage.

server.py: /api/session-test builds `entity = int(target) if target.lstrip('-').isdigit() else target`, then does `if not entity or entity == 'me'` — for target='0' this would evaluate int('0')=0 which is falsy and get reset to 'me'; edge case unlikely in practice but worth noting.
test_credentials: none — no auth. Fake account seeded into Mongo via pytest fixture.
seed_data_creation: pytest fixture 'seeded_account' inserts a TEST_ prefixed doc into accounts collection with a fake session_string; cleaned up after session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all currently-testable endpoints without real Telegram credentials. Real send / fetch-groups / valid-session flows can only be tested with a genuine Telethon StringSession + api_id + api_hash; these paths were confirmed to fail GRACEFULLY (HTTP 400 with detail) as intended. The upload path uses Emergent object storage; confirmed round-trip via GET /api/uploads/{path}. Frontend sidebar testids use pattern nav-{section} (NOT sidebar-nav-{section}).
